faq.q: What is a NAICS code?
faq.a: It is a code of the North American Industry Classification System, which groups business establishments by their primary activity so that the economic statistics of the United States, Canada and Mexico are uniform and comparable. The 2022 edition has {n_2} sectors, {n_3} subsectors, {n_4} industry groups, {n_5} NAICS industries and {n_6} six-digit U.S. industries.

faq.q: How many digits does a NAICS code have?
faq.a: Up to six. The first two digits are the sector, the third the subsector, the fourth the industry group, the fifth the NAICS industry and the sixth the national (U.S.) industry. A zero as the sixth digit generally means that the NAICS industry and the U.S. industry are the same, as in 238220 «{t_238220}».

faq.ricerca: how to find my naics code
faq.q: How do I find the NAICS code for my business?
faq.a: Start from the primary business activity. Then search the titles from the two-digit sector down to the six-digit industry, or search the alphabetic index of activities, and read the full description of the industry, including the cross-references and the illustrative examples, to check that it fits. The search box on this page covers all {n_codici} codes and the {n_idx} entries of the official 2022 index.

faq.ricerca: can i change my naics code
faq.q: Who assigns NAICS codes, and can I change mine?
faq.a: No central government agency assigns, monitors or approves NAICS codes. Each agency keeps its own list of businesses and assigns codes with its own method: for example, the Social Security Administration assigns a code to new businesses from the application for an Employer Identification Number. A code held by an agency is changed with that agency; a business does not apply for a NAICS code.

faq.ricerca: is naics code the same as sic code
faq.q: Is a NAICS code the same as a SIC code?
faq.a: No. The Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) of 1987 was the earlier U.S. system, and NAICS replaced it in 1997. SIC codes have four digits, NAICS codes up to six. The Census Bureau publishes a concordance between 1987 SIC and 1997 NAICS: our SIC to NAICS table follows it and then the later concordances up to 2022.

faq.ricerca: what is a naics code used for
faq.q: What is a NAICS code used for?
faq.a: NAICS was built to collect and publish statistics about establishments. Other bodies use it too: the IRS business activity codes for Schedule C are six-digit codes based on NAICS, and the NAICS manual notes that federal agencies have adopted NAICS for procurement and regulatory purposes even though its categories were not developed for those needs.

faq.q: Where does a NAICS-based code go on a tax return?
faq.a: On Schedule C (Form 1040) the IRS asks for a six-digit Principal Business or Professional Activity code on line B, from a list in the Schedule C instructions; the IRS says these codes are based on NAICS. For other returns, read the instructions of that form.

faq.q: Does a NAICS code say whether a business is small?
faq.a: No. The NAICS manual says that NAICS categories do not distinguish between small and large business, and that the Small Business Administration (SBA) develops size standards for each NAICS category. This site does not publish the SBA size standards: they are on the SBA website.

faq.q: Which NAICS edition does this site use?
faq.a: NAICS 2022, the edition the United States adopted in statistical programs for reference year 2022, as published in the Census Bureau files we read on {controllo}. NAICS is reviewed every five years; the 2022 manual says the next scheduled review is for a potential 2027 revision.

faq.q: What changed in NAICS from 2017 to 2022?
faq.a: According to the change indicators of the official 2022 structure, {n6_nuovi} six-digit codes are new in 2022, {n6_riusati} reuse a 2017 code with different content and {n6_titolo} changed only the title. The sector with the most new six-digit codes is {sett_piu_nuovi}. Before the revision, the government asked for comments on the treatment of electronic shopping in Retail Trade.

faq.q: Is a 2017 NAICS code still valid in 2022?
faq.a: Often yes: {n17_stessi} of the {n17} six-digit 2017 codes match exactly one 2022 code with the same number, according to the official concordance. The other {n17_altri} were renumbered, split or merged: the table on this page gives the 2022 code or codes for each of them.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for ecommerce and online retail in 2022?
faq.a: The retail trade sector of NAICS 2022 has no code just for selling online. The 2017 code 454110 (Electronic Shopping and Mail-Order Houses) is not in the 2022 structure: the official concordance splits it among {n_454110} retail codes of 2022, by the kind of goods sold, and the table on this page lists them under 454110. The official 2022 index places Internet retail sales sites of new general merchandise in 455219 «{t_455219}».

faq.q: What is a SIC code?
faq.a: A code of the Standard Industrial Classification, the U.S. industry classification of 1987 that NAICS replaced in 1997. SIC codes have four digits: the Census Bureau concordance lists {n_sic} four-digit SIC industries, grouped in two-digit major groups such as 73 «{gs_73}».

faq.ricerca: sic code to naics code conversion
faq.q: How do I convert a SIC code to a NAICS code?
faq.a: The Census Bureau's concordance links each 1987 SIC code, or each part of it, to 1997 NAICS codes. To reach the 2022 codes, this table follows the official concordances 1997 → 2002 → 2007 → 2012 → 2017 → 2022 step by step. When a SIC code was split, read the part descriptions and the description of each NAICS code to see which one fits the activity.

faq.ricerca: what is the naics code for consulting
faq.q: What is the NAICS code for consulting?
faq.a: It depends on the kind of advice. General business and management consulting is 541611 «{t_541611}»; human resources consulting is 541612 «{t_541612}»; marketing consulting is 541613 «{t_541613}»; logistics consulting is 541614 «{t_541614}»; environmental consulting is 541620 «{t_541620}»; and computer consulting is 541512 «{t_541512}».

faq.q: What is the SIC code for consulting?
faq.a: In the 1987 SIC, management consulting is 8742 «{sic_8742}» and other business consulting is 8748 «{sic_8748}». The Census concordance links 8742 to several 1997 NAICS consulting codes, one for each part.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for construction?
faq.a: Construction is sector 23, divided into subsector 236 «{t_236}», 237 «{t_237}» and 238 «{t_238}». The six-digit code depends on the main work: for example 236220 «{t_236220}», 237310 «{t_237310}» or 238220 «{t_238220}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a general contractor?
faq.a: The official index places general contractors by type of building: 236115 «{t_236115}», 236116 «{t_236116}», 236118 «{t_236118}», 236210 «{t_236210}» and 236220 «{t_236220}».

faq.q: What is the SIC code for construction?
faq.a: In the 1987 SIC, construction is three major groups: 15 «{gs_15}», 16 «{gs_16}» and 17 «{gs_17}». Each four-digit SIC code is in the SIC to NAICS table with its NAICS equivalents.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for cleaning services?
faq.a: It depends on what is cleaned. Building interiors and homes (janitorial, maid and housekeeping services) are 561720 «{t_561720}»; carpets and upholstery 561740 «{t_561740}»; building exteriors, chimneys and other services to dwellings 561790 «{t_561790}»; clothes and linens 812320 «{t_812320}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a restaurant?
faq.a: It depends on the service. In the official 2022 index, full service restaurants, family restaurants with full service and fine dining restaurants are 722511 «{t_722511}»; fast-food, carryout and drive-in restaurants are 722513 «{t_722513}»; cafeterias and buffet eating places are 722514 «{t_722514}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a bar?
faq.a: Bars, cocktail lounges and taverns serving alcoholic beverages are 722410 «{t_722410}». Nonalcoholic beverage bars at a fixed location, such as juice bars, are 722515 «{t_722515}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a coffee shop?
faq.a: The official index lists «Coffee shops, on premise brewing» under 722515 «{t_722515}». Mobile coffee carts are 722330 «{t_722330}», and coffee roasting is 311920 «{t_311920}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a bakery?
faq.a: Bakeries that bake from flour on the premises and sell for consumption elsewhere are 311811 «{t_311811}»; bakery cafes that sell for immediate consumption are 722515 «{t_722515}»; stores selling baked goods not made on the premises are 445291 «{t_445291}»; commercial bakeries are 311812 «{t_311812}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a food truck?
faq.a: 722330 «{t_722330}». The official index lists food carts and trucks, lunch wagons, mobile food stands and ice cream truck vendors there, and the official description says the establishment is the central location from which the route is served, not each vehicle.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for catering?
faq.a: Caterers and social catering services are 722320 «{t_722320}», which also includes banquet halls with catering staff. Food services provided on a contract basis, for example for hospital or school cafeterias, are 722310 «{t_722310}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for real estate?
faq.a: Real estate is subsector 531 «{t_531}». Real estate agents and brokers are 531210 «{t_531210}»; property managers are 531311 «{t_531311}» or 531312 «{t_531312}»; appraisers are 531320 «{t_531320}»; owners renting out buildings are in industry group 5311 «{t_5311}».

faq.ricerca: naics code for real estate agent
faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a real estate agent?
faq.a: 531210 «{t_531210}». The official index lists real estate agents' offices, real estate agencies and brokerages, buyers' agents and commercial real estate agents there. The IRS instructions for Schedule C use 531210 as their example of a code.

faq.ricerca: naics code for real estate investment
faq.q: What is the NAICS code for real estate investment?
faq.a: The official index places equity real estate investment trusts by the kind of property they lease: 531110 «{t_531110}», 531120 «{t_531120}», 531130 «{t_531130}» or 531190 «{t_531190}». Mortgage REITs are 525990 «{t_525990}». Buying land to subdivide it for sale is 237210 «{t_237210}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a real estate holding company?
faq.a: The index has no separate entry for real estate holding. Holding companies that hold securities of other companies without managing them are 551112 «{t_551112}»; a company that owns buildings and leases them is a lessor, for example 531110 «{t_531110}», whose description includes owner-lessors.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for rental property?
faq.a: Residential rentals such as apartments, houses and cottages are 531110 «{t_531110}»; commercial buildings are 531120 «{t_531120}»; land is 531190 «{t_531190}». The official description of 531110 includes owner-lessors and says they may manage the property themselves or have another establishment manage it.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for an Airbnb or short-term rental?
faq.a: The official index has no entry for a booking platform or for «short-term rental». Short-term lodging (except hotels, motels, casino hotels and bed-and-breakfast inns) is 721199 «{t_721199}», with guest houses, tourist homes and housekeeping cottages; bed and breakfast inns are 721191 «{t_721191}». Online accommodations reservation services are 561599 «{t_561599}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for property management?
faq.a: 531311 «{t_531311}» for homes, apartments and residential condominiums, and 531312 «{t_531312}» for commercial and other nonresidential real estate. Homeowners' and condominium owners' associations are 813990 «{t_813990}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for residential property management?
faq.a: 531311 «{t_531311}». The official index also places resort or vacation property managers' offices and managers of cooperative apartments in this code.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a holding company?
faq.a: Bank holding companies that do not manage are 551111 «{t_551111}»; other holding companies that do not manage, including personal, financial and insurance holding companies, are 551112 «{t_551112}»; holding companies that manage are 551114 «{t_551114}».

faq.q: What does NAICS code 551112 mean?
faq.a: 551112 is «{t_551112}». Its official description covers legal entities that hold the securities of other companies to own a controlling interest or influence management decisions, without administering, overseeing and managing the other establishments.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for trucking?
faq.a: General freight trucking is 484110 «{t_484110}» when local; long-distance it is 484121 «{t_484121}» or 484122 «{t_484122}». Specialized freight such as dump, flatbed, bulk liquids or livestock trucking is 484220 «{t_484220}» (local) or 484230 «{t_484230}» (long-distance).

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for an independent truck driver?
faq.a: The official index lists «Independent truck driver (except owner-operators)» under 488490 «{t_488490}». Owner-operators are excluded from that entry; the official description of subsector 484 «{t_484}» covers over-the-road transportation of cargo using motor vehicles, such as trucks and tractor trailers.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a moving company?
faq.a: 484210 «{t_484210}». The official index lists used household and office goods moving, used furniture moving and van lines offering moving and storage services there.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for logistics?
faq.a: It depends on the activity: arranging freight transportation is 488510 «{t_488510}»; logistics management consulting is 541614 «{t_541614}»; general warehousing is 493110 «{t_493110}»; carrying the goods yourself is in the transportation subsectors, for example trucking 484110 «{t_484110}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a freight broker?
faq.a: The official index has no entry with the words «freight broker». The description of 488510 «{t_488510}» covers establishments that arrange transportation of freight between shippers and carriers without providing the shipping themselves, usually known as freight forwarders, marine shipping agents or customs brokers.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a courier?
faq.a: Courier and express delivery services operating an intercity network are 492110 «{t_492110}»; local messengers, bicycle couriers and local delivery services that are not part of an intercity network are 492210 «{t_492210}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for an Uber or Lyft driver?
faq.a: No entry of the official index names Uber or Lyft. Ridesharing services and ride hailing services are listed under 485310 «{t_485310}», whose official description includes ridesharing and ride hailing services, including arrangement services.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a DoorDash driver?
faq.a: No entry of the official index names DoorDash. It lists «Restaurant meals order and delivery services (i.e., independent order and delivery services)» and grocery delivery services under 492210 «{t_492210}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for transportation?
faq.a: Transportation is sector 48-49 «{t_48-49}». The six-digit code depends on the mode and on what is carried: for example 484110 «{t_484110}» for local general freight trucking, 485310 «{t_485310}» for taxis and ridesharing, 481111 «{t_481111}» for scheduled passenger flights.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for transportation services?
faq.a: Carrying passengers or freight is classified by mode of transportation in sector 48-49. Arranging freight transportation between shippers and carriers is 488510 «{t_488510}»; travel arrangement and reservation services are in industry group 5615 «{t_5615}», outside the transportation sector.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for HVAC?
faq.a: HVAC contractors are 238220 «{t_238220}», the same code as plumbers. Wholesalers of warm air heating and air-conditioning equipment are 423730 «{t_423730}» and manufacturers of that equipment are 333415 «{t_333415}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for plumbing?
faq.a: Plumbing contractors are 238220 «{t_238220}». Wholesalers of plumbing and heating equipment and supplies are 423720 «{t_423720}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for an electrician?
faq.a: 238210 «{t_238210}». The official index lists electrical contractors, electrical work, electrical wiring contractors and solar panel installation there.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for an electrical contractor?
faq.a: Electrical contractors are 238210 «{t_238210}». Contractors building power lines are classified elsewhere: power and communication line construction, such as electric power transmission line and tower construction, is 237130 «{t_237130}» in the heavy and civil engineering subsector.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for roofing?
faq.a: Roofing contractors are 238160 «{t_238160}», including roof shingle installation and roof painting, spraying or coating. Gutter and downspout contractors are 238170 «{t_238170}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a roofing contractor?
faq.a: Roofing contractors are 238160 «{t_238160}». Selling roofing materials is a different industry: merchant wholesalers of roofing materials (except wood) and asphalt roofing shingles are 423330 «{t_423330}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a handyman?
faq.a: The official index lists «Handyman construction service, residential building» under 236118 «{t_236118}» and «Handyman construction service, commercial and institutional building» under 236220 «{t_236220}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for remodeling?
faq.a: Remodeling houses and other residential buildings is 236118 «{t_236118}», which includes remodeling general contractors, for-sale remodelers and remodeling design-build firms according to its official description.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for painting?
faq.a: House painting and painting contractors (except roofs) are 238320 «{t_238320}». Roof painting is 238160 «{t_238160}» and line painting on highways and parking lots is 237310 «{t_237310}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for landscaping?
faq.a: 561730 «{t_561730}». The official index lists landscape care and maintenance services, landscape installation services and landscape contractors (except construction) there. Landscape design and landscape architects are 541320 «{t_541320}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for lawn care?
faq.a: Lawn care is in 561730 «{t_561730}», with entries such as fertilizing lawns. Repair of lawn and garden equipment without retailing new equipment is 811411 «{t_811411}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a tree service?
faq.a: The official index lists tree services (bracing, planting, pruning, removal, spraying, surgery, trimming), arborist services and tree removal services under 561730 «{t_561730}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a hair salon?
faq.a: Unisex or women's hair stylist salons, hairdressers and beauty salons are 812112 «{t_812112}». Men's hair stylist shops and barber shops are 812111 «{t_812111}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a nail salon?
faq.a: 812113 «{t_812113}», with nail salons, manicure and pedicure salons and manicurist services in the official index.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a barber shop?
faq.a: 812111 «{t_812111}». Shops combining beauty and barber services are listed under 812112 «{t_812112}» as «Beauty and barber shops, combined».

faq.ricerca: naics code for home health care
faq.q: What is the NAICS code for home health care?
faq.a: 621610 «{t_621610}». The official index lists home health agencies, home health care agencies, medical home care of elderly and home nursing services (except private practices) there.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for non-medical home care?
faq.a: The official index lists «Home care of elderly, non-medical» and homemaker's service for elderly or disabled persons under 624120 «{t_624120}», in social assistance rather than health care.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for assisted living?
faq.a: It depends on nursing care: assisted living facilities for the elderly without nursing care are 623312 «{t_623312}»; with nursing care they are 623110 «{t_623110}»; with on-site nursing facilities they are 623311 «{t_623311}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a daycare?
faq.a: 624410 «{t_624410}». The official index lists child care services, child care in the provider's own home, babysitting services and preschool centers there. Adult day care centers are 624120 «{t_624120}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a preschool?
faq.a: Preschool centers and pre-kindergarten centers (except part of elementary school system) are 624410 «{t_624410}». Kindergartens, including kindergartens combined with preschools, are 611110 «{t_611110}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a gym?
faq.a: 713940 «{t_713940}». The official index lists fitness centers, exercise centers, health clubs and body building studios there.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a personal trainer?
faq.a: The official index lists «Personal fitness training services» under 812990 «{t_812990}». Aerobic dance and exercise instruction is 611620 «{t_611620}», and yoga or pilates instruction is 611699 «{t_611699}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for physical therapy?
faq.a: 621340 «{t_621340}», with physical therapists', occupational therapists' and physiotherapists' offices in the official index.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for massage therapy?
faq.a: The official index lists massage therapists' offices (centers, clinics) under 621399 «{t_621399}» and massage wellness spas or centers under 812199 «{t_812199}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for event planning?
faq.a: Party planning services are 812990 «{t_812990}»; convention or trade show event planners are 561920 «{t_561920}»; organizers of arts, sports and similar events are 711310 «{t_711310}» with facilities or 711320 «{t_711320}» without.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a wedding planner?
faq.a: The official index lists «Wedding planning services» under 812990 «{t_812990}». Wedding photography services are 541921 «{t_541921}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a wedding or event venue?
faq.a: The index has no entry called «wedding venue». Renting out a banquet hall is 531120 «{t_531120}»; banquet halls with catering staff are 722320 «{t_722320}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for photography?
faq.a: Portrait, wedding and school photography services are 541921 «{t_541921}»; commercial, medical and aerial photography services are 541922 «{t_541922}»; independent artistic photographers are 711510 «{t_711510}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for video production?
faq.a: Motion picture and video production, including television commercials, is 512110 «{t_512110}». Video taping of special events such as weddings is 541921 «{t_541921}», and commercial event videography is 541922 «{t_541922}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a church?
faq.a: 813110 «{t_813110}». The official index lists churches, mosques, places of worship, religious ministries, missions and monasteries there.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a religious organization?
faq.a: Religious organizations are 813110 «{t_813110}», the same code as churches. Religious schools are classified as schools: in the official index, Bible colleges offering baccalaureate degrees are 611310 «{t_611310}» and Bible schools (except degree granting) are 611699 «{t_611699}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a nonprofit?
faq.a: There is no NAICS code for being a nonprofit. The NAICS manual says an establishment is classified in an industry when its primary activity meets the definition for that industry; for example grantmaking foundations are 813211 «{t_813211}», advocacy organizations for the environment 813312 «{t_813312}» and food banks 624210 «{t_624210}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for software development?
faq.a: Custom software development is 541511 «{t_541511}». Developing and publishing applications for sale, except on a custom basis, is 513210 «{t_513210}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for IT consulting?
faq.a: The official index lists computer software consulting services, computer hardware consulting services and systems integration design under 541512 «{t_541512}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for web design?
faq.a: The official index lists «Web (i.e., Internet) page design services, custom» under 541511 «{t_541511}». Web hosting is 518210 «{t_518210}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for marketing?
faq.a: Marketing consulting is 541613 «{t_541613}»; advertising agencies are 541810 «{t_541810}»; marketing research is 541910 «{t_541910}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for digital marketing?
faq.a: The official index lists digital advertising agencies, Internet advertising agencies and online advertising agencies under 541810 «{t_541810}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for graphic design?
faq.a: 541430 «{t_541430}», with graphic design services, commercial art services and logo design services in the official index.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a staffing agency?
faq.a: Temporary help services and contract staffing services are 561320 «{t_561320}»; employment placement agencies are 561311 «{t_561311}»; professional employer organizations and employee leasing are 561330 «{t_561330}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for an employment agency?
faq.a: 561311 «{t_561311}», with employment agencies, employment placement services and non-executive recruitment services in the official index. Executive search services are 561312 «{t_561312}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a law firm?
faq.a: 541110 «{t_541110}». The official index lists law firms, law offices, lawyers' and attorneys' offices and practices there.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a notary public?
faq.a: The official index lists notary public services and notary publics' private practices under 541199 «{t_541199}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for accounting?
faq.a: Offices of certified public accountants are 541211 «{t_541211}»; accountants who are not CPAs are 541219 «{t_541219}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for bookkeeping?
faq.a: 541219 «{t_541219}», with bookkeeping services, bookkeepers' offices and billing services in the official index.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for tax preparation?
faq.a: 541213 «{t_541213}», with tax return preparation services and income tax return preparation services in the official index.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for an insurance agency?
faq.a: 524210 «{t_524210}», with insurance agencies, insurance brokerages and life insurance agencies in the official index.

faq.q: Do insurance brokers have a different code from agents?
faq.a: No. The official index lists insurance brokerages in the same code as insurance agencies, 524210 «{t_524210}». Claims adjusting is 524291 «{t_524291}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for engineering?
faq.a: 541330 «{t_541330}», with engineering services, engineering consulting services and consulting engineers' offices in the official index.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for an architect?
faq.a: Architects (except landscape) are 541310 «{t_541310}»; landscape architects are 541320 «{t_541320}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for auto repair?
faq.a: General automotive repair shops are 811111 «{t_811111}»; brake, transmission, exhaust and other specialized repair shops are 811114 «{t_811114}»; body and paint shops are 811121 «{t_811121}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a car wash or detailing?
faq.a: 811192 «{t_811192}», with car washes, self-service and mobile car washes and automotive detailing services in the official index.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for towing?
faq.a: 488410 «{t_488410}», with tow truck services, wrecker services and emergency road services in the official index.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for ecommerce?
faq.a: There is none in NAICS 2022. The retail trade sector groups retailers by the merchandise line carried, and its description says retailers often reach customers through Internet websites. Internet retail sales sites of new general merchandise are 455219 «{t_455219}» in the official index.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for an Amazon seller?
faq.a: No entry of the official index names Amazon. In NAICS 2022 an online retailer is classified like other retailers, mainly by the merchandise line carried: for example clothing is 458110 «{t_458110}» and electronics 449210 «{t_449210}». The 2017 to 2022 table shows the 2022 codes for the old 454110.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a retail store?
faq.a: Retail trade is sector 44-45 «{t_44-45}». The six-digit code follows the merchandise sold: for example grocery stores are 445110 «{t_445110}», clothing stores 458110 «{t_458110}» and general or variety stores 455219 «{t_455219}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a clothing store?
faq.a: 458110 «{t_458110}», with family, women's, men's and children's clothing stores in the official index.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for manufacturing?
faq.a: Manufacturing is sector 31-33 «{t_31-33}». The six-digit code depends on the product: for example petroleum refineries are 324110 «{t_324110}» and wood household furniture other than upholstered is 337122 «{t_337122}». The NAICS manual says the code is assigned on the principal product or group of products produced.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for a hotel?
faq.a: 721110 «{t_721110}» for hotels without casinos and motels; 721120 «{t_721120}» for casino hotels. In the official index, hotel management services providing the staff to run the hotel are also 721110, while management without complete operation is 561110 «{t_561110}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for business consulting?
faq.a: The official 2022 index lists business management consulting services, business start-up consulting services and general management consulting services under 541611 «{t_541611}».

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for janitorial services?
faq.a: 561720 «{t_561720}». The official index lists janitorial services, office cleaning services and housekeeping services there.

faq.q: What is the NAICS code for pressure washing?
faq.a: The official index lists «Pressure washing (e.g., buildings, decks, fences)», power washing and steam cleaning of building exteriors under 561790 «{t_561790}».
